stories.title: Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define response schema to expose matched_classifications and pipeline origin metadata (regex, vector, or both). Include fields for classification label, confidence (if available), and source_pipeline.

stories.title: Pipeline Attribution Logic
stories.description: Enhance specialty_service to tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or merged) and ensure deduplicated classifications retain provenance metadata.

stories.title: API Exposure of Specialty Transparency
stories.description: Update facade and API response models to include matched classifications with pipeline attribution for downstream consumption by chat responses.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Match Transparency
stories.description: Update chat message rendering to optionally display specialty match explanations, including classification labels and indication of pipeline origin, in a user-readable format.

stories.title: Specialty Transparency Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating that classifications include correct pipeline attribution, API responses conform to schema, and frontend rendering handles presence/absence of transparency metadata.
